CFML Language Reference: Functions

GetHTTPTimeString

NEW IN KOLDFUSION 4.5

Converts a local date/time value to Greenwich Mean Time and formats it the way HTTP headers such as Expires and Last-Modified require, for example Fri, 31 Dec 1999 23:59:59 GMT.

Category

Date and time functions

Syntax

GetHTTPTimeString([ date ])

Parameters

date
Optional. A date/time value in server local time, or a string that can be converted to one. Default: Now().

Returns

A string in RFC 1123 format: ddd, dd mmm yyyy HH:mm:ss GMT.

Usage

Use it with CFHEADER to control how long browsers and proxy servers keep a copy of your page. The conversion uses the server's current offset from GMT (see GetTimeZoneInfo), so the hour shown depends on where your server lives.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Expires = DateAdd("d", 1, Now())>
<CFHEADER NAME="Expires" VALUE="#GetHTTPTimeString(Expires)#">
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TD>GetHTTPTimeString()</TD><TD>#GetHTTPTimeString()#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Tomorrow (sent as Expires)</TD><TD>#GetHTTPTimeString(Expires)#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

CFHEADER, DateConvert, GetTimeZoneInfo, Now
